name: For Honor

angles.text: As a warrior, you know the weight of battlefield sacrifice. Remembering fallen combatants keeps their deeds alive.

faq.answer: For Honor asks you to remember fallen fighters. Your efforts keep their sacrifices from fading.
faq.q: What is the quest For Honor about?

faq.answer: The warriors are fallen fighters honored for their deeds. Your actions preserve their memory and the service they gave.
faq.q: Who are the warriors mentioned upon completion?

faq.answer: Remembering fallen warriors gives their sacrifice dignity. It keeps their courage acknowledged.
faq.q: Why is honoring these warriors important?

faq.answer: Someone seeking to remember fallen comrades directs the work. When you return, they confirm it is done and acknowledge the warriors' memory.
faq.q: Who asks for this task to be done?

aliases: is for honor part of a chain
faq.answer: The text points to no further work. For Honor honors fallen fighters and their sacrifices.
faq.q: Does this quest lead to other tasks?

faq.answer: For Honor names the duty of remembering fallen soldiers. Keeping their sacrifice and battlefield memory alive is a solemn duty for any fighter.
faq.q: What does the title For Honor signify?

sections.body: Those who outlive fallen warriors carry their memory forward. Remembering those who gave everything is a duty.
sections.title: A Duty of Remembrance

sections.body: Your efforts keep the fallen fighters alive in memory. Those who remember them continue to honor their sacrifices.
sections.title: Preserving the Legacy

summary: Fallen warriors live on in memory through For Honor. Their sacrifices endure in the minds of those who remember them.
